[SWS_DM_00479] is followed.
–
Persistent Storage of failed attempts to change security level:
After each increment of the attempt counter, it shall be persisted to survive
accidental or intended resets. Selecting the
persistent storage
is mandatory
in Adaptive Autosar.
• 0x29 Authentication:
–
The DM only implements
Authentication with PKI Certificate Exchange
(APCE), as described in ISO 14229-1:2020[1] chapter 10.6.2.
–
Authentication with Challenge-Response
(ACR), as described in ISO 14229-
1:2020[1] chapter 10.6.3, is currently out of scope.
• 0x2A ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier: Only
scheduler type 1
is supported.
